drhp.business: Sunrest Lifescience Limited is engaged in the trading business of pharmaceutical products on a wholesale basis. The Company derives operational synergies from its subsidiary, Hetvi Lifesciences Private Limited, which has further strengthened its business capabilities and enhanced its presence across key segments of the pharmaceutical industry.
drhp.mdna: India's pharmaceutical industry continues to witness strong growth, driven by increasing healthcare awareness, rising domestic demand, supportive government initiatives, and expanding opportunities in global markets (Chairman's Message)
drhp.one_liner: Ahmedabad-based wholesale trader of pharmaceutical products, operating through subsidiary Hetvi Lifesciences Private Limited to expand its presence across pharma segments.

risks.note: Since the Company's equity share capital is listed exclusively on the NSE Emerge Platform, Corporate Governance Report and Business Responsibility Report requirements are not applicable to the Company, meaning it is exempted from the fuller governance and ESG disclosure regime that applies to main-board listed peers (MD&A section).
risks.risk: Reduced governance/disclosure oversight as an SME (NSE Emerge) listed entity

risks.note: The Company Secretary, Ms. Neelam Gattani, resigned on 13 January 2026 and was replaced by Mr. Nabil Ansari, appointed on 16 January 2026, indicating a short KMP transition gap during the year (Board's Report / Secretarial Audit Report).
risks.risk: Key managerial personnel (Company Secretary) turnover during the year
